Commercial Terms

Single-event partnership · Amanda Serrano: The Last Walk · 9 January 2027

Partnership Framework

Term
Single-event partnership for Saturday 9 January 2027.
Event
Amanda Serrano: The Last Walk · 9 January 2027 · San Juan, Puerto Rico
Territory
US
Category Exclusivity
Betr is the Official Gaming Partner of Amanda Serrano: The Last Walk in the US, for the full event and fight week.
Financial Commitment
$250,000

Partnership Assets

Rights & Presenting Partner
01

Trademark Rights & Official Designations

  • Use of event and MVP official marks across all Betr marketing
  • ‘Official Gaming Partner of Amanda Serrano: The Last Walk’
  • Non-exclusive designation: ‘Official Partner of MVP’
02

Presenting Partner

  • Status: ‘Amanda Serrano: The Last Walk, presented by Betr’
  • Event marketing & promotion: event IP rights, with Betr featured and tagged across all event promotion (digital, social, posters, press)
Fight Night
03

Ring & In-Arena

  • 1 × centre ring mat logo, 1 × bumper post, 1 × ring rope strap
  • LED ribbon boards and jumbotron
  • Betr-branded LED wristbands for all attendees
  • Brand audio reads from the ring announcer through the night
04

Broadcast

  • 2 × :30 commercial, other broadcast integrations
  • Subject to broadcaster rules
05

Betr Bolt Moment

  • Betr bolt graphic and replay on the in-arena screens for the biggest moment of the night, chosen by MVP production
  • Clipped and posted on MVP social, tagging Betr
Fight Week & Onsite
06

Fight Week

  • Verbal mentions and step & repeat at the open workout, press conference, weigh-in and post-fight press conference
  • 10 × 10 activation space at fight week and fight night (pending venue rules)
07

Creator Access Program

  • Up to three (3) Betr streamers or creators, agreed by both parties
  • Fight week access: open workout, press conference and weigh-in
  • Fight night access: VIP tickets, production table viewing, backstage access and content zone
  • Content: ringside cameo and collab posts on MVP social
  • Creator fees, travel and accommodation covered by Betr; content subject to MVP approval
Collectibles
08

Canvas Collectibles Giveaway

  • A piece of the Betr-branded ring mat from Serrano’s final fight, given away to Betr users
  • MVP: cuts, authenticates and announces the giveaway on MVP social, tagging Betr
  • Betr: runs the competition in-app, selects the winner and ships the prize
09

‘The Last Walk’ Rips Drop

  • Limited Betr Rips drop of Serrano’s final-fight memorabilia: signed gloves, fight poster, merch
Content & CRM
10

Social & Content

  • 2 × fight-week posts on MVP social, agreed in advance, with logo inclusion and tag of Betr
  • MVP Uncut or Face2Face sponsor
  • Pre-event content: press conferences, weigh-ins, face-offs and promos
  • Post-event content: official photos and recap videos
  • Usable across Betr-owned channels, subject to agreed rules
11

CRM

  • Dedicated Betr email send to MVP’s opted-in US fan database during fight week
Hospitality & Management
12

VIP Hospitality

  • 4 × floor and 4 × lower bowl tickets on fight night
  • 4 × tickets to each fight-week event
  • 5 × PPV codes (if applicable)
13

Account Management

  • A dedicated MVP Account Director for the event, with a post-event performance summary

Performance Framework

How app installs and FTDs are built into every activation and tracked across The Last Walk

Every activation at The Last Walk carries a trackable call to action, from fight week to the final bell. Results are reported straight after the event and shape any longer-term MVP partnership.

The Performance Flywheel

1
Integrate

A trackable call to action built the  activation: MVP offer, codes, QR codes and tracked links

→
2
Drive

Fight week, fight night and after the bell: MVP moments send fans into the Betr app

→
3
Measure

Installs, registrations, FTDs and Rips sales traced back to each activation, creator and event

→
4
Optimise

More weight to the best-performing activations, creators, content and offers at the next event

↻ Learnings from The Last Walk feed straight into a longer-term MVP partnership

What We’re Driving

App installsNew Betr users from MVP fans
RegistrationsVerified sign-ups in eligible states
FTDs & RipsFirst time deposits and Rips sales
Return playersPlayers coming back every event

Tracking

Reporting

  • Post-event review against agreed targets
Agreed at kick-off

  • Baseline performance and targets
